import sqlite3

def sqlite_basic(value):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
    conn.execute('CREATE TABLE t (v TEXT)')
    conn.execute('INSERT INTO t VALUES (?)', (value,))
    return conn.execute('SELECT v FROM t').fetchone()[0]
